label: Teltonika RUTM31
description: A cost-efficient 5G router: 1 WAN + 1 LAN at gigabit and dual-band Wi-Fi 5, with a 5G Sub-6 modem and LTE Cat 12/13 fallback.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTM31 datasheet: 1 x WAN port 10/100/1000 Mbps and 1 x LAN port 10/100/1000 Mbps; 5G Sub-6 GHz SA/NSA at 2/2.6 Gbps downlink (4x4 MIMO), 1000/650 Mbps uplink; LTE Cat 12 600 Mbps / Cat 13 150 Mbps as fallback; 802.11b/g/n/ac Wave 2 (Wi-Fi 5) dual band up to 867 Mbps. Modelled at the 2 Gbps SA figure - the slower of the two downlink numbers the vendor quotes.
